标准模板仅支持支出、收入。金额为实付/实收，优惠金额只用于支出，原价=金额+优惠: The standard template supports expenses and income. Amount is the actual amount paid or received; expense discounts record original-price information without deducting money again. Enter level 1 and 2 categories; level 3 and transaction IDs are optional. Products apply to expenses; use notes for income descriptions. Completed transactions can be imported, failed/closed/cancelled records are excluded, and pending or unknown statuses require review.
金额为实付/实收；优惠只记录支出原价信息，不再次扣款。收入须为0或留空。: Amount is the actual amount paid or received. Discounts record expense original prices without deducting money again. Income discounts must be zero or blank.
参数已修改，请刷新期表后核对。保存时也会重新计算；已有逐期修改会保留。: Parameters changed. Refresh the schedule for review. Saving also recalculates and retains installment edits.

收入分录取反计收入；费用分录计支出。优惠按实际入账金额统计，拆分付款不重复计消费: Income uses negated income entries; expenses use expense entries. Discounts follow actual posted amounts and split payments are counted once.
按退款到账日期冲减费用与原分类；跨期退款不回写原月份，允许负净支出。: Refunds reduce expenses and original categories on receipt date. Earlier months are unchanged and negative net expenses are allowed.
本金不计收支；相关费用按手续费开关处理。: Principal is excluded; related fees follow the fee setting.
借贷本金、垫付及收回不作为普通收支；实际费用按账本分录统计。: Loan principal, advances and collections are excluded from ordinary income and expenses. Actual costs follow ledger entries.
期初余额、余额调增不作为普通收入；账户余额和净资产不受统计开关影响。: Opening balances and upward adjustments are not ordinary income. Policy switches do not affect balances or net worth.
使用 Asia/Shanghai 的交易发生日期；不同币种分别统计，不自动换汇。: Uses transaction dates in Asia/Shanghai. Currencies are reported separately without automatic conversion.
使用未删除的已入账交易；计划、提醒、待确认导入不产生统计分录。: Uses posted transactions that have not been deleted. Plans, reminders and unconfirmed imports do not create reporting entries.
全账本收支、预算及复盘沿用统计规则；账户资金流动、薪酬归属月及专项业务指标保留各: Ledger income, expenses, budgets and reviews follow these rules. Account movements, payroll attribution months and specialist metrics retain their own definitions.

管理十类统计规则、预设方案与真实账本预览: Manage ten groups of rules, presets and real-ledger previews
账户净资产为账本余额推算；综合估值另列，不与账户余额或投资损益重复相加。历史期初: Account net worth is estimated from ledger balances. Consolidated valuation is separate and is not added again to balances or investment gains. Missing opening-date history limits attribution; the difference is not investment return.
原币统计。基准货币决定默认查询币种，不自动折算历史交易。: Reports use original currencies. The base currency sets the default query currency without automatically converting historical transactions.
三个全账本开关作用于现有报表；其余方案配置作用于本页口径分析，现有预算仍按自然月: The three ledger-wide switches apply to existing reports. Other options apply to this policy analysis. Existing budgets still use calendar months and ledger-wide rules.
奖励、利息与投资现金收益仅按明确业务关联识别；未建立关联的手工收入保留为其他收入: Rewards, interest and investment cash income are identified only by explicit business links. Unlinked manual income remains other income; names are not used to guess its nature.
净日常结余、流动账户现金流结余及净资产变化为不同指标。退款不计收入，跨期退款按到: Daily surplus, liquid-account cash surplus and net-worth changes are distinct metrics. Refunds are not income and are reported on receipt date.
工资、投资与债务附表不再次加入日常收支；未来计划始终与已发生金额分列。: Payroll, investment and debt schedules are not added again to daily income and expenses. Future plans remain separate from actual amounts.
现金流指标仅含现金、银行、支付宝、微信和电子钱包；同币种流动账户间转账按交易抵销: Cash-flow metrics cover cash, bank, Alipay, WeChat and electronic wallets. Same-currency transfers between liquid accounts are netted by transaction, while fees remain and adjustments and losses are excluded. Account rows include transfers and adjustments and must not be summed as cash inflows or outflows.
工资独立附表，不代替银行到账。归属口径将工资月份视为该月1日；actual为所选: Payroll is a separate schedule, not bank receipts. Earned months use the first day of the month. Linked receipts cover selected slips up to the report cutoff. Net salary equals gross less deductions plus adjustments. Employer contributions are not disposable income.
借款与本金偿还按真实业务流水；剩余本金仅含已登记借入业务。利息和手续费仅含有效已: Borrowing and repayments use actual business transactions; outstanding principal covers registered borrowing only. Interest and fees include valid reconciled allocations; missing reconciliation does not mean zero fees. Planned payments use current active plans and allocations and create no consumption or debt. Current plans and classifications are not historical snapshots.
期间价差损益与分红利息分列，费用已在成本或净所得中，不再次从收益扣除。未实现为各: Realized trading gains and dividend or interest income are separate. Fees already enter costs or net proceeds and are not deducted again. Unrealized gains cover valued positions at period end. Cash flows include trade principal and are not investment return. IRR/XIRR is not calculated; original currencies are reported separately.
